import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { executeBackendCaveCommand, sendCaveCommandFallback } from '@src/api/bot/cave-command';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { presentBackendCavePlots } from '@src/response/cavePlot/info/res';
import { sendSelfCavePlotPage } from '@src/response/cavePlot/render';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const match = (e.MessageText ?? '').match(/开垦(?:\s+(\d+))?$/);
  const plotIndex = match?.[1] ? Number(match[1]) : undefined;
  const result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(String(bid), uid, { action: 'cultivate', plotIndex }, createBackendRequestContext(e));
  const overview = result.overview;

  if (!overview || result.snapshotError) {
    sendCaveCommandFallback(result, bid, isPrivate, message, '开垦灵田');

    return;
  }

  sendSelfCavePlotPage({
    title: '开垦灵田',
    bid,
    isPrivate,
    message,
    plots: presentBackendCavePlots(overview.plots),
    leadText: result.message
  });
});
